title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face, forming the first loop with four straight lines. The first line starts at the origin and ends at coordinates [0.0277, 0.0]. The second line extends vertically from this point to [0.0277, 0.0175]. The third line moves horizontally back to [0.0, 0.0175], and the fourth line completes the rectangle by returning to the origin. Apply a scale factor of 0.0277 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Rotate the sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it with the same vector to position it correctly. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to create a three-dimensional rectangular base. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. This extrusion will form a new solid body. The final dimensions of the part are a length of 0.02768989736842105 units, a width of 0.0175232447368421 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0277, 0).lineTo(0.0277, 0.0175).lineTo(0, 0.0175).close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# The final model
r = cylinder

     .lineTo(0.0277, 0.0) \
